analysis: This PR as supplied contains only documentation changes: a new changelog fragment (changelog.d/qwen38-reasoning-effort-400.md) and docs/architecture/inference.md, which adds a paragraph about template raise_exception classification and a new error-table row for unsupportedReasoningEffort (400). No source code was included, so the described behavior is unverified here. The behavioral claims concern Qwen4SupportPolicy.validateReasoningContext, which would reject unsupported reasoning effort values (anything other than low/medium/xhigh) with a typed HTTP 400 before Jinja rendering, and media preparation, which would rethrow typed request errors instead of wrapping them as a 503 capacity_busy. Security-wise this is neutral to mildly positive: it is early input validation, it moves a client fault from 500/503 to 400, and it avoids misleading retry signals. I found no new attack surface in the docs and no change to encryption, attestation, authorization, the coordinator-to-provider trust boundary (TB-002), or the prefix-cache threat T-041. Residual points for the next pass if code arrives: (1) the media-path rethrow must not swallow or leak plaintext prompt content in error details (A-001) and must keep error messages sanitized; (2) the typed 400 must be emitted before any decrypted content is logged; (3) the capacity_busy-to-400 change affects coordinator retry and routing behavior, so check that it cannot be used to drain provider reputation or availability (T-010, T-057 not directly affected). No findings are warranted from the docs alone.
